[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [string]$ProjectId,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [int]$CanonicalIssue,

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $false)]
    [string]$AllowedActor = "jyun121388-spec"
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$ProgressPreference = "SilentlyContinue"

function Write-Log {
    param([string]$Message)
    Write-Host "[ai-event-review] $Message"
}

function ConvertTo-SafeMarkdownText {
    param([AllowNull()][object]$Value)
    if ($null -eq $Value) { return "" }
    $text = [string]$Value
    # Prevent a model-produced HTML comment from spoofing the idempotency marker.
    return $text.Replace("<!-- ai-review-event:", "&lt;!-- ai-review-event:")
}

function Get-GitHubHeaders {
    param([string]$Token)
    return @{
        Authorization        = "Bearer $Token"
        Accept               = "application/vnd.github+json"
        "X-GitHub-Api-Version" = "2022-11-28"
        "User-Agent"         = "4os-ai-event-review"
    }
}

function Get-AllIssueComments {
    param(
        [string]$Repository,
        [int]$IssueNumber,
        [hashtable]$Headers
    )

    $all = @()
    $page = 1
    do {
        $uri = "https://api.github.com/repos/$Repository/issues/$IssueNumber/comments?per_page=100&page=$page"
        $batch = @(Invoke-RestMethod -Method Get -Uri $uri -Headers $Headers)
        $all += $batch
        $page++
    } while ($batch.Count -eq 100)

    return $all
}

function Post-IssueComment {
    param(
        [string]$Repository,
        [int]$IssueNumber,
        [string]$Body,
        [hashtable]$Headers
    )

    $uri = "https://api.github.com/repos/$Repository/issues/$IssueNumber/comments"
    $payload = @{ body = $Body } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8
    return Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri $uri -Headers $Headers -ContentType "application/json; charset=utf-8" -Body ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($payload))
}

function Find-EventId {
    param([string]$Body)
    $matches = [regex]::Matches($Body, '\[(ESC-[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+|TEST-[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)\]')
    if ($matches.Count -eq 0) { return $null }
    return $matches[$matches.Count - 1].Groups[1].Value
}

function Find-CommitSha {
    param([string]$Body)

    $patterns = @(
        '(?im)"?appliedCommit"?\s*[:=]\s*["''`]?([0-9a-f]{7,40})',
        '(?im)"?headCommit"?\s*[:=]\s*["''`]?([0-9a-f]{7,40})',
        '(?im)"?baseHead"?\s*[:=]\s*["''`]?([0-9a-f]{7,40})',
        '(?im)\bHEAD\s*[:=]\s*["''`]?([0-9a-f]{7,40})'
    )

    foreach ($pattern in $patterns) {
        $match = [regex]::Match($Body, $pattern)
        if ($match.Success) { return $match.Groups[1].Value }
    }

    return $null
}

function Format-Bullets {
    param(
        [AllowNull()][object[]]$Items,
        [string]$EmptyText = "- None."
    )

    if ($null -eq $Items -or $Items.Count -eq 0) { return $EmptyText }
    return (($Items | ForEach-Object { "- " + (ConvertTo-SafeMarkdownText $_) }) -join "`n")
}

function Format-BlockingFindings {
    param([AllowNull()][object[]]$Items)
    if ($null -eq $Items -or $Items.Count -eq 0) { return "- None." }

    $lines = @()
    $index = 1
    foreach ($item in $Items) {
        $severity = ConvertTo-SafeMarkdownText $item.severity
        $finding = ConvertTo-SafeMarkdownText $item.finding
        $evidence = ConvertTo-SafeMarkdownText $item.evidence
        $action = ConvertTo-SafeMarkdownText $item.required_action
        $lines += "$index. **[$severity] $finding**`n   - Evidence: $evidence`n   - Required action: $action"
        $index++
    }
    return ($lines -join "`n")
}

function Select-ReviewModel {
    param(
        [string]$EventKind,
        [string]$Body
    )

    if ($Body -match '(?i)\[TEST-' -and $EventKind -eq 'CLAUDE_APPLIED') {
